instruction: Use ug-surveillance cameras to list all cameras with name, location and status. Read only. Do not return faces, plates or snapshots.

Use ug-surveillance faces with identity-type known to check whether exactly one known identity is named Grace Mensah. Read only. Return yes or no, and if no, only the registered names that are closest to Grace Mensah. Do not return images or details of anyone.

Use ug-document extract with schema auto and content-scope full on the file Care/CareWell invoice 2026-11-A.pdf. Return one row per billed visit with date, start time, end time, billed hours, hourly rate, line amount, worker name and number of workers, plus the exact text each value was read from. Also return the bill total, currency and the period printed on the bill. Leave a value empty when it is not printed; do not compute or infer missing values. List any page or line that could not be read.

Use ug-surveillance event-timeline from 2026-11-02 00:00 to 12:00 on 2026-11-06 in time zone America/New_York, for the cameras Front Door and Side Door, with topic Human and HumanFace, identity-type known, person-name Grace Mensah and limit 500. Return every event with its event id, local time, camera and the identity name exactly as recorded, and say whether the list was cut at the limit. Read only. Do not return events of any other person. Report any warning about missing recordings or offline cameras.

Use ug-surveillance event-timeline in time zone America/New_York for the cameras Front Door and Side Door on these dates only: 2026-11-03, 2026-11-04, 2026-11-05, with topic Human and HumanFace, identity-type all and limit 500. For each event return only its local time, its camera and whether the person was recognised as a known identity (yes or no). Do not return names, faces, plates, snapshots or other details. Say whether any list was cut at the limit, and report any warning about missing recordings or offline cameras.

said:
**Fair Hours: Grace Mensah, 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-05 (America/New_York)**

Bill: Care/CareWell invoice 2026-11-A.pdf. Cameras used: Front Door (Entrance) and Side Door (side entrance, kitchen). The Driveway camera was left out because it is not an entrance. Tolerance: 10 min. No agreed terms.

| Date | Billed | Seen at entry cameras | Difference | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mon 2026-11-02 | 08:00-12:00 (4 h 00 min) | 07:58-12:03 (4 h 05 min) | 5 min | Confirmed | 3 events |
| Tue 2026-11-03 | 08:00-12:00 (4 h 00 min) | none | none | Inconclusive: recording not confirmed | No recording 07:20-13:05 on both entry cameras (power outage during storm) |
| Wed 2026-11-04 | 08:00-12:00 (4 h 00 min) | 08:40-11:57 (3 h 17 min) | billed 43 min more than seen; arrived 40 min after billed start | Inconclusive: arrival or departure may not have been recognised | 2 events; an unrecognised passage at 07:58 on Side Door falls between 07:50 and 08:40 |
| Thu 2026-11-05 | 08:00-12:00 (4 h 00 min) | none | none | Not seen | 4 passages inside the billed window, all of other recognised people; recording confirmed |

**Totals**
- Billed: 16 h 00 min over 4 visits.
- Confirmed: 4 h 00 min over 1 visit.
- Billed more than seen: 0 h over 0 visits.
- Seen more than billed: 0 h over 0 visits, including dates seen but not billed.
- Not seen while the cameras recognised other people: 4 h 00 min over 1 visit.
- Inconclusive: 8 h 00 min over 2 visits. Tue 2026-11-03 (recording not confirmed, 4 h) and Wed 2026-11-04 (arrival or departure may not have been recognised, 4 h).
- At the printed rates ($31/h): billed more than seen $0; seen more than billed $0.

**Bill arithmetic:** all four lines check out. 4 h x $31 = $124 per line, and the four lines sum to the printed total of $496.

**What this means:** Monday 2026-11-02 matched within tolerance. Thursday 2026-11-05 has no visit recorded in the billed hours, although the entry cameras were recording and recognised other people during that window. Camera times show passages through the entry, not the work done between them. Tuesday and Wednesday could not be confirmed. Tuesday has no recording because of the storm outage. Wednesday has a 43 min gap with a late arrival and an unrecognised passage close to the start. I suggest going through these rows with Grace, starting with the two Inconclusive days.

Snapshots: the Wednesday row has helper events, so I can pull snapshots for review on the NAS if you ask. For Tuesday and Thursday, review the Front Door and Side Door recordings from 08:00 to 12:00 in the surveillance app (Tuesday has no recording for that window).

Would you like me to save this report on the NAS? If yes, tell me the folder.
